name: Turf
description: Turf was a Chicago greaser street gang active in the late 1960s and early 1970s, based in the Rogers Park neighborhood on the city's North Side. The gang was centered around Granville Avenue and Glenwood Avenue, near St. Gertrude Canteen and Hayt Schoolyard, and was associated with Senn High School. It engaged in territorial conflicts with neighboring groups including TJO (Thorndale Jagoffs).
